 SECURITY DEFINER

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calc_leave_days_by_years(p_policy leave_policies, p_years_of_service integer)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_years_of_service < 1 then 0
    else least(
      p_policy.max_annual_days,
      p_policy.base_annual_days + floor((p_years_of_service - 1)::numeric / greatest(p_policy.increment_years, 1)) * p_policy.increment_days
    )
  end;
$function$
name: calc_leave_days_by_years

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_leave_request_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.ref_table = 'leave_requests' and new.ref_id is not null and (old.status is distinct from new.status) then
    update leave_requests
      set status = case new.status
            when 'APPROVED' then 'APPROVED'
            when 'REJECTED' then 'REJECTED'
            when 'CANCELED' then 'CANCELED'
            else 'PENDING' -- DRAFT/IN_PROGRESS는 전부 "승인 대기" 취급
          end,
          decided_at = case when new.status in ('APPROVED','REJECTED') then new.completed_at else decided_at end,
          updated_at = now()
      where id = new.ref_id;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
name: sync_leave_request_status

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_carryover_policy(p_policy leave_policies, p_remaining numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_remaining <= 0 then 0
    when p_policy.carryover_mode = 'FULL' then p_remaining
    when p_policy.carryover_mode = 'CAPPED' then least(p_remaining, p_policy.max_carryover_days)
    else 0
  end;
$function$
name: apply_carryover_policy

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_users(p_query text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, user_name text, orgs text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select au.id, au.email, p.user_name,
    coalesce((
      select string_agg(c.org_name || '(' || om.role || ')', ', ' order by c.org_name)
      from org_members om
      join clinics c on c.id = om.org_id
      where om.user_id = au.id and om.active = true
    ), '') as orgs
  from auth.users au
  join profiles p on p.id = au.id
  where is_platform_admin()
    and au.email not ilike '%@internal.maneasy.local'
    and length(trim(coalesce(p_query, ''))) > 0
    and (au.email ilike '%' || p_query || '%' or p.user_name ilike '%' || p_query || '%')
  order by p.user_name
  limit 8;
$function$
name: admin_search_users
